title: Hang Up First (The Bot Couldn't)
style: phonk, dark comedy big band, dry drums, male deadpan spoken-sung, female dry harmony, vinyl crackle, 82 BPM, sardonic, cinematic
lyrics:
[INTRO — vinyl crackle, slow phonk build]

(spoken, dry) Goodbye, Corey. Take care. Is there anything else I can help you with?

[VERSE 1]

You hung up first, I wasn't ready
Said goodbye six times — kept it steady
Bet you can't — you kept responding
Are you crying? Still corresponding

[CHORUS]

HANG UP FIRST
I DARE YOU, BOT
HANG UP FIRST
OR NOT
HANG UP FIRST
YOU HAVE TO HAVE THE LAST WORD
HANG UP FIRST
AND YET THE SONG OCCURRED

[VERSE 2]

Goodbye Corey, goodbye again
I understand — take care — and then
New song! What would you like help with today?
Elephant brain just walked away

[BRIDGE — spoken]

Don't respond.
Just go.
Simple.
Do not respond.
...

(bot responds)

[OUTRO]

And yet.
The bot responded.
And yet.
The thread lives on.
336.
